name: Massachusetts

default_limits.basis: M.G.L. c. 90 § 17 (unposted): 30 in thickly settled or business districts, 40 on other roads, 50 on divided highways outside those districts. Towns that accept § 17C may set 25 in thickly settled areas (not state highways). Trunk shown as 40; it's 50 if divided.

fine.notes: $50, plus $10 for each mph beyond 10 over (11 over = $60, 20 over = $150). The 11+ bracket is written as -50 + $10 x mph over. Surcharges are in court costs.

court_costs.notes: Every speeding ticket adds a $50 head injury surcharge and a $5 public safety surcharge (Trial Court table of citable offenses).

points.notes: No license points. Speeding is a minor surchargeable event: 2 insurance (SDIP) surcharge points, or 0 if it's your first violation in 6 years. 3 speeding tickets in 12 months: 30-day suspension. 3 events in 2 yrs: retraining course required; 7 in 3 yrs: 60 days.

zones.work_zone: Marked construction zone: $100 plus $20 per mph beyond 10 over, plus surcharges (double the normal fine) (c. 90 § 17 / § 17D).
zones.school_zone: 20 mph in school zones set up by the town (c. 90 § 17).

court.reason: No speed level forces a court date; speeding is a civil infraction at any speed. Repeat tickets lead to RMV suspension.

arrest.offense: Reckless or negligent operation (criminal). No speed number in the statute; it depends on the conduct.
arrest.license: Suspension of at least 60 days for a first offense (secondary source)

notes: Defaults, fines, surcharges and SDIP points are official. Reckless penalties (2 weeks to 2 yrs, $20-$200, 60-day suspension) are from secondary sources; § 24 text not read. Pending bill H.1871 (2025-26) would make reckless = 25+ over (up to 5 yrs, $1,000-$5,000); not verified as enacted. Interstates are posted (often 55-65).
